blocks.prompt: 7 Solve the following trigonometric equation: \(\sqrt{2}\cos x\sin x - \sin x = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Dono terms mein \(\sin x\) mojood hai. Yahan sab se bari ghalti yeh hoti hai ke bache \(\sin x\) cancel kar dete hain; hum use common nikalenge.
Is se do basic equations milengi: \(\sin x = 0\) aur \(\cos x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\). Yaad rakhiye: cancel karna asal mein divide karna hai, aur jo cheez zero ho sakti hai us se divide karna jawab chura leta hai.
Find kya karna hai? Principal solutions aur general solution.
Plan: factorise, dono cases hal, families ka union.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sqrt{2}\cos x\sin x - \sin x = 0\).
Maloom karna: principal solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\sin x\) common nikal kar factorise karenge, phir har factor ko zero rakhenge.

\(\sin x\) common nikalein
\[\sin x\left(\sqrt{2}\cos x - 1\right) = 0\]
\[\sin x = 0\ \text{ or }\ \cos x = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: product zero tab hi hota hai jab koi factor zero ho. Doosre factor se \(\sqrt{2}\cos x = 1\), yani \(\cos x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).
Dhyan dein: agar \(\sin x\) se divide kar dete to \(0, \pi, 2\pi\) jaise jawab hamesha ke liye gum ho jate.

Jab \(\sin x = 0\)
\[x = 0,\ \pi,\ 2\pi\]
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein; aam taur par \(x = n\pi\).
Kyun: unit circle par sine (y-coordinate) sirf x-axis wale do points par zero hota hai, yani \(\pi\) ke har multiple par. Is liye \(0 + 2n\pi\) aur \(\pi + 2n\pi\) mil kar \(n\pi\) bante hain.

Jab \(\cos x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\)
Cosine positive: quadrant I aur IV, reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\).
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
\[x = 2\pi - \dfrac{\pi}{4} = \dfrac{7\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: table se \(\cos\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\); quadrant IV ka angle \(2\pi - \alpha\).

General solution
\[\left\{n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{7\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Kyun: pehle case ki family \(n\pi\) hai, doosre ki do families \(2n\pi\) ke saath (cosine ka period \(2\pi\)). Teeno ka union poora jawab hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{4}:\ \sqrt{2}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} - \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = 0\]
Kyun: \(\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \cos\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\), to pehla term \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) bana aur doosre ne use cancel kar diya. \(x = n\pi\) par to dono terms mein \(\sin x = 0\) hai, is liye wahan bhi zero aata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Kitab ke examples ki tarah hum principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein aur general solution sets ke union ki shakal mein dete hain. Aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
